info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Partners-v1-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Partners API provides access to a diverse list of partners associated with hotel loyalty programs. It enables developers to retrieve information on loyalty point partnerships that enhance customer engagement and benefits within hospitality services. Typical consumers of this API include mobile applications, web platforms, and third-party services that aim to integrate loyalty features for users. This endpoint streamlines the process of accessing partner data, supporting effective loyalty initiatives and customer reward strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of partners associated with points.
get.description: This endpoint allows the client to fetch the details of partners linked to points in the system. This includes all necessary information that enables effective management and interaction with the partners.

requestBody.description: Retrieve information regarding partner points. The request body should contain necessary parameters as defined in the schema to facilitate the retrieval process.

200.description: The request was successful, and the partner points data is returned.
